rule: Only registered worktrees are removed, each with `git worktree remove <exact path>` and only when clean; nothing is forced. Every untracked or modified file is first compared with a committed blob (git hash-object vs git rev-parse <commit>:<path>); only verified duplicates and this wave's own superseded outputs are deleted, by exact path list (no wildcard). node_modules junctions are unlinked first (DirectoryInfo.Delete on the reparse point), so the main tree's node_modules is never followed. Unregistered directories are only marked SAFE_TO_DELETE.
final_state: git worktree list = the main working tree only; git worktree prune found nothing
